usageNotes: Use this endpoint to inspect the MAC VRF routing table for a specific VNet on an EVPN zone — it returns every MAC-IP binding that the queried node either self-originates or has learned via BGP from remote VTEPs. The VNet must belong to an EVPN-type SDN zone; calling it against a VXLAN or simple zone will yield no meaningful results. The caller requires SDN.Audit permission on the specific zone/vnet path, and the target node must be online and have the SDN configuration applied.

examples.summary: Retrieve MAC VRF entries for VNet 'prod01' from node 'pve1'

tips: Results are node-scoped: the same VNet queried from different nodes may show different BGP-learned entries depending on each node's EVPN peering state.
An empty array is normal when no VMs are active on the VNet or BGP sessions have not yet converged.
The 'nexthop' field is the VTEP IP of the remote node that advertised the route — useful for tracing which physical host owns a given MAC.
SDN configuration must have been applied (via pvesh POST /cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/apply or the Proxmox UI) before this endpoint reflects current state.
